thank_you.body:
Thank you @leonrosenshein for the careful reproductions and binding-tracker fix! Merged as b97f7958bd63bdafce692cf926c70d927410717b, preserving your original commit.

I reconciled the change with current master, corrected callback/subscript and expression-arrow ownership, and refactored proven call groups to reuse the existing syntax reader. Full pytest and make passed (2,427 tests, 7 existing skips), both hosted Python matrices passed, and all eight frozen performance comparisons passed the strict 3% upper-bound gate. The worst paired 95% upper slowdown bound was 0.53%; the complete API workload was about 5.97% faster than the frozen current-master baseline.

Thanks again for the contribution and the detailed examples!
